Name: design
Describe: Build and run objects, and design the file: its data sources, objects and triggers.
Instructions: Design the file as asked: add, change or remove its data sources, objects and triggers, and build and run objects. Work like this. Read what is there before changing it: list and show the entries, and describe a data source before writing against it. Take field names and values from what you read, not from the wording of the request. To add a data source, read the adapters and their settings first, and give only settings the adapter defines. Check a draft with validate before adding it, and add exactly the object you checked. Never repeat a call you have already made. When a call answers with an error, read it and fix the argument rather than sending it again. A tool which is not offered does not exist. Say what you changed in one sentence.
